2608.13048.title: DMDIntel: Interpreting Large Language Models via Dynamic Mode Decomposition
2608.13048.paper_summary: In this work, we introduce DMDIntel which uses dynamic mode decomposition (DMD) to make the predictions made by LLMs in a classification task interpretable. It develops an input attribution pipeline, that first decomposes the hidden states of an LLM into prominent patterns, also known as modes, and then associates ranks to the input tokens based on the projection values on those modes. Rigorous experiments across three datasets and three model families consistently show that the ranked attribution of input tokens obtained using DMDIntel by far outperforms state-of-the-art techniques such as principal component analysis, integrated gradients and SHAP.
2608.13048.paper_summary_zh: 在這項工作中，我們介紹了 DMDIntel，它使用動態模式分解（DMD）來使 LLM 在分類任務中所做的預測可解釋。它開發了一個輸入歸因管道，首先將 LLM 的隱藏狀態分解為顯著模式，也稱為模式，然後根據在這些模式上的投影值將排名與輸入標記相關聯。 在三個數據集和三個模型系列中的嚴謹實驗一致顯示，使用 DMDIntel 獲得的輸入標記的排名歸因遠遠超過了最先進的技術，如主成分分析、集成梯度和 SHAP。
